title: To make notes lock option available
body: Everything is great but in 2026 we need an option to lock out notes something like 2 factor authentication or any sort of locking system on this app please.
author: Mr. shakya

title: Bug
body:
Please solve this bug, I noticed it after updating to ios 16:
Whenever I open a long note, and scroll down and click in middle of the note to edit middle part, the note moves all the way up to the first word in the note and I have to scroll it down again
author: manndipp

title: Awesome
body:
Awesome app with all features and even can be sync with multiple devices. 
Advice: App lock system either password/thumb/face scan would be much appreciated. Anyway thanks.
author: Amitm12

title: LACK OF NOTE LOCK FEATURE
body: I would have given it 5 stars if it had note lock feature like other apps. It doesn’t make sense that company as big as GOOGLE  hasn’t added such a small but really useful feature. If you guys read the user reviews by any chance then please consider adding the feature in upcoming updates. It would be very beneficial to lock some individual notes which we need to keep private from prying eyes. 😀
author: prajwal01
